_comment: MapleIdle 'chapter challenge'(per-stage: waves then a stage boss). stages[dungeonIndex]={mob:{hp,def}, boss:{hp,def}|null}. ★Each challenge STAGE has its OWN boss (the IsBoss mob at the end of that stage's waves) — NOT the chapter final boss. Stage boss def == that stage's wave-mob def; boss HP is higher. ch1~2 have no per-stage boss (boss=null). Chapter final boss is separate (monster_hp/defense boss, used for the 보스 target). formula=CreatureStatTable[creature].Stat x MonsterTierTable[tier].StatRatio/1000.
_source: DungeonTable(IsTrial=True, RushDefence) -> OverrideFamilyIndex -> CampFamilyTable1[family].Monster (mob=most-freq non-boss, boss=IsBoss) -> CreatureStatTable x MonsterTierTable /1000
